description: Without price_list_id creates a price list (title required); with price_list_id updates it. 'set_prices' adds or changes the price of a variant in a currency; 'remove_variants' drops variants from the list. type 'sale' shows the original price struck through, 'override' simply replaces it. Plain dates use the reporting timezone.

customer_group_ids.description: Only for these customer groups; [] or null = everyone

remove_variants.description: Variant IDs whose prices are removed from the list

name: save_price_list
title: Create or update price list
